name: Multnomah County, OR
findings: Multnomah County has 3,853 nonprofit organizations. 1,920 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,584 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Multnomah County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Multnomah County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 155 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
